raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
- restore `verl.trainer.main_generation` as a backward-compatible wrapper around `main_generation_server`
- translate legacy CLI overrides like `data.path`, `data.n_samples`, `model.*`, and `rollout.*`
- update generation examples/e2e script to use the current `main_generation_server` entrypoint
- defer `openai` import in `main_generation_server` so the compatibility shim can be imported without optional deps
- add a CPU regression test for the legacy CLI translation path

## Testing
- pytest -q tests/trainer/test_main_generation_on_cpu.py

Closes #5593

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the prompt generation entry point by moving the core implementation to `main_generation_server` and introducing a backward-compatibility layer in `main_generation.py` to translate legacy CLI arguments. Example scripts and tests have been updated to use the new server and argument schema. A bug was identified in the `_translate_legacy_cli_args` function where the Hydra '+' prefix for configuration overrides is incorrectly stripped during translation, which could lead to runtime errors when adding new keys to the configuration.

+
+from verl.trainer.main_generation import _translate_legacy_cli_args
+
+
+def test_translate_legacy_main_generation_args():
+    translated = _translate_legacy_cli_args(
+        [
+            "trainer.nnodes=1",
+            "data.path=/tmp/prompts.parquet",
+            "data.prompt_key=prompt",
+            "data.n_samples=3",
+            "data.output_path=/tmp/out.parquet",
+            "model.path=Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct",
+            "+model.trust_remote_code=True",
+            "rollout.temperature=0.7",
+            "rollout.top_p=0.9",
+            "rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=2",
+        ]
+    )
+
+    assert "trainer.nnodes=1" in translated
+    assert "data.train_files=/tmp/prompts.parquet" in translated
+    assert "data.prompt_key=prompt" in translated
+    assert "+data.output_path=/tmp/out.parquet" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=3" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.model.path=Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.model.trust_remote_code=True" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=0.7" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=0.9" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=2" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm" in translated
+
+
+def test_preserve_explicit_rollout_backend():
+    translated = _translate_legacy_cli_args(
+        [
+            "rollout.temperature=1.0",
+            "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=trtllm",
+        ]
+    )
+
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0" in translated
+    assert "actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=trtllm" in translated
+    assert translated.count("actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=trtllm") == 1

+    has_rollout_name = False
+    saw_legacy_rollout_arg = False
+

+        remapped = arg
+        if "=" in arg:
+            key, value = arg.split("=", 1)
